Roberto De Zerbi faces scrutiny over team performance

Roberto De Zerbi, the manager of Brighton & Hove Albion, is facing scrutiny regarding his team's performance, particularly in relation to upcoming matches and past results. Reports suggest he must address specific issues to avoid difficult questions, especially concerning his team's ability to perform against strong opposition like Tottenham. There is also mention of an "Everton opportunity" and a specific interaction with a player named Mathys Tel after a perceived outburst.
